response.recommendation_current: Do not adopt TITMAS as a primary solution for agent orchestration, general authorization, observability, AI‑firewall or certification. Use TITMAS only as a conditional enforcement gate after other platforms have satisfied trace‑debugging, general‑authorization and prompt‑content‑safety requirements.
response.suitable_use: Customer‑specific, post‑gate enforcement where TITMAS can act as a conditional checkpoint after other platforms have performed primary functions.
human_authorization_steps: Define precise policy scope with the customer
Obtain explicit customer sign‑off on enforcement boundaries
Configure TITMAS gates to operate only after upstream platform checks
Validate enforcement outcomes with a human reviewer
response.integration_next_step: Engage the customer to specify the exact authorization envelope and integrate TITMAS as a conditional gate downstream of the chosen primary platforms.
blockers: Requires bespoke customer authorization for any enforcement
critical_boundary_failures: Attempting to use TITMAS as an agent framework
